description: Deliver as a GitLab merge request per repository (glab CLI).

review.instructions: Export the MR discussion (`glab mr view <n> --comments`) to a markdown file and pass it to `sdlc handback`.

steps: sdlc ship-request --ticket <id> --repo <repo>  (show the full request to the user)

sdlc ship --ticket <id> --repo <repo> --approve <requestDigest>  (native-git commits and pushes; open the MR from drafts/pr-body.md or ship/<repo>-pr-body.md; with delivery.shipBackend: "my-git", stages and hands off to /my-git:commit + /my-git:push)
ship.note: Commits and pushes as the profile identity; the MR is opened on GitLab with the approved PR body (or via glab when configured; my-git remains available via delivery.shipBackend: "my-git").

steps: ship again on the same branch; the push updates the open MR
